mechanism: Sumatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with fluphenazine (dopamine antagonist with some serotonergic effects) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and extrapyramidal side effects through additive serotonergic and dopaminergic pathway disruption.
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia) and extrapyramidal effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower serotonergic activity or non-triptan migraine therapy if possible.
